text_block_list.text:
Today, Calstone Light O and Durandal were paired together for training in a specialized environment.
The VR Umalator was used for this purpose.
choice_data_list: Then we'll set the conditions to rain and heavy turf.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Which course should we choose?
Nakayama 1,200m seems the most sensible, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
Now then, let's step inside the aircraft.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Here's the input panel, alright.
Machines usually start working if you press OK. Let's just OK everything!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Wait, the course and condition selection—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I won't wait. We're starting at top speed!
Hyaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Kya! An outfit change!?
What did you pick—Light O-san!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Where am I?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: That's my line!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: It appears you selected Game Mode instead of Race Mode.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Just as I thought.
It seems I've been sucked into a VR fighting game.

I operate the system panel to check our current situation.
It appears to be a stage from a fighting gameâa battle-royale
format where all team members fight at the same time.
choice_data_list: Let's drop out for now and re-set our pace partner settings.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hm, fastest clear time, 1 minute 7.7 seconds.
Then that record, I shall surpass it!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Believe, Durandal!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...W-Well, it can't be helped~.
I suppose I could keep you company, just this once?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I'll take the knight character!
Please pick different characters, you two."
choice_data_list: Somehow we ended up playing a game, but...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Normally, Durandal-san
would correct our course, but—"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: That looks hard this time, so I'll just aim to clear the game.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're okay with that...?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
There's no stopping those two once they get like that.
Clearing it is the best course of action.
It seems there's nothing left to do but steel myself.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Attack is the only option. I am... fast. Haaaah!

Calstone Light O relentlessly mashed heavy attacks while moving forward.
Closing in on her opponent, she occasionally transitioned into a throw.
Durandal, on the other hand, is aiming for a single decisive strike.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
First Sword, Roland's...! Hey!!
Attacking while I'm inputting commands is totally unfair!?

"Meanwhile, Believe, who thoroughly read the manual,
fought in textbook fashion with basic attacks and guards.
Each of their personalities clearly showed in their play."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Defeated again...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
We can't win. Why?
Forget setting a record clear time, we're not even close.
What absolute small fry we turned out to be!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's come up with a plan!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"That sounds like a good idea.
Do you have any breakthrough strategies?"
Believe guarded skillfully, barely losing any of her health gauge. However, she lacked a decisive finishing blow, so—
choice_data_list: Unleash a flurry of attacks with Light O!

text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O's flaw was that landing a throw would drop her combo.
If Believe can cover for that...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I see, I cover Right-O-san's openings and keep the combo going... I'll give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—Leave clearing the path to me.
I shall serve as your shield and protect both of your lives!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Keep a fixed distance using light attacks.
Please continue attacking.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Oh, their attacks are relentless. Then I shall raise my speed. Let's go, Believe!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Non-stop top speed!
Believe covered openings with her attacks and guards, successfully chaining combos to seize victory!

"A finishing blow really is the most potent trump card.
If Believe can support her through positioning
so Durandal can unleash her ultimate technique...!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I see. I'll draw the enemy's attention
and pass it to Durendal-san when the moment is right.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I'd truly appreciate that.
I will make sure my decisive strike lands...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Hit and run, draw them all in.
Gather them in one spot and...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —Now's the time! Durandal-san, go for it!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Fourth Sword: Dionysus's Lightning Spear!
With Believe drawing the enemy's attention, Durandal landed her special move, securing a brilliant victory!
Believe had the best situational awareness among the three. If she instructed the other two on attack types and timing, they might just have a chance at victory...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone-san, unleash a barrage of light attacks on nearby foes.
Durandal-san, strike distant enemies with your aura blast technique."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Two down... only one left.
Everyone, all-out attack on the enemy leader!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

Working together while making the most of their individual fighting styles,
they achieved a brilliant victory!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —You're back, I see.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, things just turned out this way, but...
I think we put up quite a good fight, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
However, it didn't reach the fastest clear time.
One more time—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Nakayama Racecourse, 1200m, rainy weather,
Heavy track conditions. Setup complete."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Let us begin the tandem run.
